caption: The drawing features a single ceramic pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, lightly textured background. The pitcher is depicted with a rounded body, a narrow neck, a slightly flared rim, and a single curved handle attached to the upper body and rim. The surface of the pitcher is mostly a warm yellowish-beige color, decorated with irregular patches of brown and green, some of which appear to be in a marbled or streaked pattern. The handle of the pitcher is a reddish-brown shade, and the rim has some brown and green stains similar to those on the body. The base of the pitcher is also outlined with a reddish-brown ring. The artwork is rendered in a realistic style, with careful attention to light and shadow to give the object a three-dimensional appearance. The drawing is signed "John Ferrentino" in small print at the lower right corner within the frame. The entire composition is set within two faint rectangular borders.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
